battle.name: 第二次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 1956年10月，英法聯軍與以色列對埃及蘇伊士運河區發動軍事行動，法國裝甲單位投入已列裝的AMX-13輕型坦克。

kit.name: AMX-13輕型坦克
kit.history: 1953年列裝法軍，1956年配屬於投入蘇伊士運河區的法國裝甲單位。

countries: 1956年10月，以色列、英國與法國三國联合發動了對埃及的軍事行動，史称第二次中東戰争或苏伊士危机。以色列在戰略上以确保蒂朗海峡安全、阻止埃及對以列的封锁为借口，出動第7裝甲旅及第84裝甲师等精锐部队，从西奈半岛向埃及纵深推進。英國则借口保护苏伊士運河的國际航運，调動第3步兵师、海軍陆戰队第3旅以及第1伞兵团，组成“馬斯克特”特遣部队。法國的目标同样聚焦于運河控制，派遣第1海軍步兵团、第2空降团以及裝甲第5旅，协同英軍實施两栖登陆與空中突击。埃及方面则以其正规軍第4裝甲师、第6步兵师及新成立的第1航空旅迎戰，辅以苏制T-34、IS-3重型坦克以及米格-15、米格-17拦截机，形成防御與反击的作戰體系。整场冲突的阵营划分清晰，交戰双方均在兵力规模、火力配置和指挥體系上做了充分的预演與调動。
countriesEn: In October 1956, Israel, the United Kingdom, and France launched a joint military operation against Egypt, an event commonly referred to as the Second Middle East War or the Suez Crisis. Israel justified its involvement by the need to ensure the security of the Strait of Tiran and to break the Egyptian blockade, deploying elite units such as the 7th Armored Brigade and the 84th Armored Division from the Sinai Peninsula deep into Egyptian territory. The United Kingdom, citing the protection of international shipping through the Suez Canal, mobilized the 3rd Infantry Division, the Royal Marine Commandos’ 3rd Brigade, and the 1st Parachute Regiment to form the Musketeer task force. France similarly aimed to safeguard its influence over the Canal, committing the 1st Marine Infantry Regiment, the 2nd Airborne Regiment, and the 5th Armored Brigade, and coordinated with British forces for an amphibious landing and air assault. Egypt responded with its regular forces, including the 4th Armored Division, the 6th Infantry Division, and the newly established 1st Air Brigade, supported by Soviet‑supplied T‑34 and IS‑3 heavy tanks as well as MiG‑15 and MiG‑17 interceptors, creating a combined defense and counter‑attack posture. The alignment of the two camps was clear, with each side undertaking extensive preparation in manpower, firepower, and command structures.
people: 這场戰役背后有多位關键的指挥官與政治领袖。以色列方面，总参谋長達扬·梅纳赫姆（Moshe Dayan）统筹全局，第7裝甲旅旅長约瑟夫·拉帕波特（Yosef Rapaport）與第84裝甲师师長尤里·本·阿里（Yuri Ben‑Ari）负责前线突击；后续担任北部軍区指挥官的阿里埃勒·沙龍（Ariel Sharon）则在西奈東翼组织机動防御。英國指挥官包括陆軍中将查尔斯·基特利（Sir Charles Keightley），负责指挥“馬斯克特”行動的地面部队；海軍中将约翰·霍尔（Admiral Sir John Hall）指挥两栖登陆编队；空軍中将哈罗德·哈丁（Air Marshal Sir Harold Hard）负责空中支援與制空权争夺。法國方面，第1海軍步兵团指挥官安德烈·博弗雷（General André Beaufre）担任地面作戰指挥官，空降部队指挥官皮埃尔·拉勒芒（General Pierre Lalaumont）策划伞降行動。埃及领导人包括总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔（Gamal Abdel Nasser），以及軍队总司令阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿米尔（General Abdel Hakim Amer），在防线上指挥第4裝甲师和第6步兵师。這些将领的經验與决策直接影响戰役的進程與结局。
peopleEn: The conflict was driven by several key military and political figures. On the Israeli side, Chief of Staff Moshe Dayan coordinated overall strategy, while the commander of the 7th Armored Brigade, Yosef Rapaport, and the commander of the 84th Armored Division, Yuri Ben‑Ari, led the front‑line thrust; Ariel Sharon, later the commander of the Northern Command, organized mobile defense on the eastern flank of the Sinai. British commanders included Lieutenant‑General Sir Charles Keightley, who oversaw the ground phase of the Musketeer operation; Vice‑Admiral Sir John Hall, who directed the amphibious landing group; and Air Chief Marshal Sir Harold Hard, who managed air support and the contest for air superiority. The French contingent was led by General André Beaufre as the ground commander and General Pierre Lalaumont, who planned the parachute drops. Egyptian leadership comprised President Gamal Abdel Nasser, who directed national policy, and the army’s commander‑in‑chief, General Abdel Hakim Amer, who commanded the 4th Armored Division and the 6th Infantry Division on the defensive line. The experience and decisions of these individuals directly shaped the campaign’s progress and ultimate outcome.
kits: 在裝备层面，各方均投入了当時现役的主力武器系统。以色列裝甲部队主要配备M4“谢尔曼”中型坦克以及在其基础上改裝的M50“超级谢尔曼”，配备75毫米或90毫米炮；另配备法國制造的AMX-13轻型坦克，裝有高频炮塔，可快速机動。以色列空軍使用美國的F-86“軍刀”喷气式戰斗机和法國的“狂風”（Ouragan）及“神秘”（Mystère）IV戰斗机，执行對地支援與空中拦截任务。運输方面使用C-47“達科他”運输机投放伞兵。英國裝甲力量以“Centurion”主戰坦克为主，配备105毫米炮，另有“Charioteer”快速坦克和“Conqueror”超重型坦克提供火力支援；空中力量则依赖“霍克猎人”（Hawker Hunter）拦截机以及“英國电气堪培拉”（English Electric Canberra）中型轰炸机，后者携带1000磅炸弹對埃及机场進行精准轰炸。海軍動用“威尔士亲王”级航空母舰“ HMS Bulwark”和“ HMS Eagle”，以及两栖登陆舰“ HMS Fearless”和“ HMS Boxer”。法國裝甲部队使用“AMX-13”和“潘哈德EBR”裝甲侦察車，空軍配备“神秘IV”和“狂風”以及“诺德-阿塔克”攻击机。埃及则拥有苏制T-34/85中型坦克、IS-3重型坦克以及英國提供的“十字軍”巡航坦克，并配备米格-15、米格-17以及美國出售的F-86“軍刀”（后期）以争夺空中優势。双方的火炮包括M-46 130毫米野戰炮、L/60 25磅炮以及法國制造的“喀山”155毫米自行榴弹炮，构成了對地压制的火力网。
kitsEn: Each side fielded the most capable equipment then in service. Israeli armor relied heavily on the M4 Sherman medium tank and its upgraded M50 Super Sherman variant, armed with a 75‑mm or 90‑mm gun, supplemented by French‑made AMX‑13 light tanks with a high‑velocity turret for rapid maneuver. The Israeli Air Force operated American F‑86 Sabre jets and French Ouragan and Mystère IV fighters for ground attack and air‑interception missions, while C‑47 Dakota transports dropped paratroops. British forces deployed the Centurion main battle tank, equipped with a 105‑mm gun, as well as the Charioteer fast tank and the Conqueror heavy tank for fire support; the Royal Air Force used Hawker Hunter interceptors and English Electric Canberra medium bombers, the latter dropping 1,000‑lb bombs on Egyptian airfields. The Royal Navy contributed the carriers HMS Bulwark and HMS Eagle and amphibious ships such as HMS Fearless and HMS Boxer to lift troops and armor. French armor consisted of AMX‑13 and Panhard EBR reconnaissance vehicles, while their air arm flew Mystère IV, Ouragan, and Nord‑Atak attack aircraft. Egypt’s arsenal included Soviet T‑34/85 medium tanks, IS‑3 heavy tanks, and British‑supplied Cromwell tanks, as well as MiG‑15 and MiG‑17 interceptors and later American F‑86 Sabres to contest the skies. Artillery across all sides comprised 130‑mm M‑46 field guns, 25‑pounder (L/60) guns, and French 155‑mm self‑propelled howitzers, providing a dense fire‑support network for ground operations.
tactics: 作戰中，各方采用了多兵种协同的合成戰术。以色列在開局阶段先以步兵與裝甲混编的快速纵队穿越西奈，利用“谢尔曼”與“超级谢尔曼”的火力压制埃及前沿阵地，随后在關键路口展開裝甲會戰，辅以小型的“瓦茨”式自行高炮提供低空防护。以色列伞兵部队在加沙地带與阿里什地区使用C-47運输机進行低空空投，快速占领机场并建立前進基地。英國與法國则采取两栖登陆與空降相结合的方式，英法联軍先以海軍舰炮對塞得港的防波堤進行炮击，随后第1伞兵团和第2空降团在港口東侧進行伞降，切断埃及軍队的补给线；紧接着第3步兵师和第1海軍步兵团的LST登陆舰冲滩，卸载“Centurion”坦克與裝甲車，组成压倒性的裝甲冲锋。法方在空降后立即组织“神秘IV”戰斗轰炸机對埃及裝甲集结地進行低空轰炸，使用1000磅炸弹摧毁T-34/85與IS-3的阵地。为防止埃及空軍的米格-15突袭，英方“霍克猎人”全程保持高空巡逻，拦截進入作戰区域的敌机。整體而言，合成兵种的快速机動、空中優势的争夺以及两栖登陆的协同构成了戰役的主要作戰模式。
tacticsEn: The battle unfolded through a series of combined‑arms tactics. Israel began with a rapid armor‑infantry column crossing the Sinai, using Shermans and Super Shermans to suppress Egyptian forward positions, then concentrated at key crossroads for armored engagements, supported by small self‑propelled anti‑aircraft guns for low‑altitude protection. Israeli paratroopers used C‑47 transports to conduct low‑altitude drops near Gaza and El‑Arish, quickly seizing airfields and establishing forward bases. The British‑French coalition executed an amphibious‑airborne convergence: naval gunfire battered Port Said’s sea wall, after which the 1st Parachute Regiment and 2nd Airborne Regiment dropped east of the port, cutting Egyptian supply lines; the 3rd Infantry Division and 1st Marine Infantry Regiment then stormed the beaches from LSTs, unloading Centurions and other armor to form a crushing armored thrust. French Mystère IV fighter‑bombers conducted low‑level strikes against Egyptian armor concentrations, delivering 1,000‑lb bombs to knock out T‑34/85 and IS‑3 positions. To counter Egyptian MiG‑15/17 interceptors, Hawker Hunters maintained high‑altitude patrols and engaged any hostile aircraft entering the operational area. In sum, the interplay of rapid ground maneuver, the contest for air superiority, and coordinated amphibious‑airborne operations defined the campaign’s tactical landscape.
data: 从時間线來看，戰役大致分为四個阶段。1956年10月29日，以色列第7裝甲旅與第84裝甲师在清晨越過埃及邊境，向阿里什與加沙方向快速推進，同日英法两國向埃及發出最后通牒，要求停止對運河的軍事行動。10月31日，英法空軍發動首轮空袭，動用“英國电气堪培拉”轰炸埃及開罗、亚历山大港的空軍基地，摧毁若干架米格-15與米格-17；随后英法联軍在塞得港實施两栖登陆，第1伞兵团在港口東侧降落，形成對港口的双向包围。11月5日，英法部队的第3步兵师在裝甲支援下突破埃及防线，占领塞得港并控制運河入口，随即展開對埃及裝甲部队的扫荡。11月6日，在美國與苏联联合施压以及联合國安理會决议的背景下，各方宣布停火并同意撤軍。整個冲突持续约十日，以色列投入约45,000名官兵，英法合计约60,000名，埃及動员约70,000名，具體傷亡数字因资料來源不同而存在差异。以色列在十天的高强度作戰中损失若干坦克與数架戰机，英法部队合计损失若干裝甲車和少数士兵，埃及方面则损失较多裝甲車辆和若干架飛机。
dataEn: The operational timeline can be divided into four main phases. On 29 October 1956, Israel’s 7th Armored Brigade and 84th Armored Division crossed the Egyptian border at dawn, advancing toward El‑Arish and Gaza; the same day Britain and France issued an ultimatum demanding the cessation of hostilities in the Canal zone. On 31 October, British and French air forces launched the first wave of strikes, using English Electric Canberras to bomb Egyptian air bases in Cairo and Alexandria, destroying several MiG‑15 and MiG‑17 aircraft; this was followed by the amphibious landing at Port Said, where the 1st Parachute Regiment dropped east of the port, encircling it from both sides. By 5 November, the British‑French 3rd Infantry Division, backed by armored support, broke through the Egyptian defensive line, seized Port Said, and secured the entrance to the Canal, subsequently clearing Egyptian armor from the area. On 6 November, under joint United States‑Soviet diplomatic pressure and a United Nations Security Council resolution, all parties declared a cease‑fire and agreed to withdraw forces. The whole conflict lasted roughly ten days; Israel committed roughly 45,000 troops, while the United Kingdom and France together deployed about 60,000, and Egypt mobilized around 70,000. Precise casualty figures vary among sources, but each side suffered losses in tanks, aircraft, and personnel during the high‑intensity fighting.
cause: 第二次中東戰争的根源深植于20世纪50年代的中東政治格局。二戰结束后，英國與法國仍试图维持對苏伊士運河的控制权，以确保其殖民帝國在该地区的經济與軍事投射。與此同時，埃及在纳赛尔总统的领导下，坚定推行民族主義政策，于1956年7月宣布将苏伊士運河公司國有化，旨在掌握運河收益用于國內建设，這一舉動直接触動了英法的核心利益。以色列则将埃及封锁蒂朗海峡、禁止以色列船只通過红海视为生存威胁，并通過宣傳阿拉伯國家的軍事集结來争取西方支持。美苏两超在冷戰格局下的竞争亦在此次危机中显现：美國倾向于通過外交手段迫使英法撤軍，以削弱英法在欧洲的影响；苏联则利用此机會向埃及提供軍事援助并在國际舞台上谴责西方列强的侵略行为。综合來看，運河國有化引發的领土與經济争夺、以色列的安全忧虑以及大國在中東的势力争夺，共同构成了戰争的直接导火索。
causeEn: The roots of the Second Middle East War lie in the geopolitical landscape of the 1950s. After World War II, Britain and France sought to preserve their dominance over the Suez Canal, a vital artery for their imperial trade and military projection. In Egypt, President Gamal Abdel Nasser’s nationalist agenda culminated in July 1956 when he nationalized the Suez Canal Company, intending to use the revenues for domestic development; this move directly threatened British and French economic interests. Israel viewed the Egyptian blockade of the Strait of Tiran and the prohibition of Israeli shipping through the Red Sea as an existential threat and exploited Arab military buildup to gain Western support. The Cold War also played a role: the United States, seeking to reduce European colonial influence, pressed Britain and France to withdraw, while the Soviet Union supplied Egypt with arms and condemned Western aggression. The confluence of canal‑ownership disputes, Israeli security concerns, and great‑power rivalry thus provided the immediate catalyst for war.
impact: 戰争的后果在政治、軍事與地区格局上均留下深遠影响。首先，英法两國在美苏的强大外交與經济压力下被迫宣布停火并在短期內撤軍，标志着老牌殖民帝國在中東的统治力大幅削弱。其次，联合國安理會通過的停火决议首次在國际舞台上确立了通過多邊机构解决地区冲突的模式，为后來的维和行動提供了先例。以色列虽然短期內實现了對蒂朗海峡的通航安全，但其對西奈的占领被迫在停火后归還，导致其在阿拉伯世界的孤立状态加深。埃及则在戰争中保持了领土完整，纳赛尔的民族主義声望得到提升，進一步巩固了對阿拉伯世界的领导地位，并在随后得到苏联更多軍事援助，推動了阿拉伯國家與苏联的軍事合作。整體而言，苏伊士危机加速了中東地区的去殖民化進程，重新塑造了大國在该地区的介入方式，为后续的阿以冲突埋下伏笔。
impactEn: The war produced far‑reaching political, military, and regional consequences. First, Britain and France, facing strong American and Soviet diplomatic and economic pressure, were forced to declare a cease‑fire and pull their forces out within weeks, marking the effective end of their colonial dominance in the Middle East. Second, the United Nations Security Council’s cease‑fire resolution set a precedent for multilateral conflict resolution and laid the groundwork for future peacekeeping operations. Israel, although it achieved temporary security for its Red Sea passage, was required to withdraw from the Sinai under the cease‑fire, deepening its isolation in the Arab world. Egypt, meanwhile, retained control of the Canal, and Nasser’s successful resistance enhanced his prestige across the Arab sphere, leading to increased Soviet military aid and closer Arab‑Soviet cooperation. Overall, the Suez Crisis accelerated the decolonization of the Middle East, reshaped the way great powers intervened in the region, and set the stage for subsequent Arab‑Israeli confrontations.
result: 最终，第二次中東戰争以各方停火并撤离戰场告终。1956年11月6日，英法两國在联合國和美國的外交压力下同意停止軍事行動，随后在11月7日前完成从塞得港及運河地区的撤退。以色列在联合國调解下亦于12月前撤回西奈，仅保留對加沙地带的部分控制。埃及重新掌握苏伊士運河的全部主权，并在随后数年內對運河進行现代化改造，使其成为全球最重要的航運通道之一。政治层面，纳赛尔通過成功抵御西方列强的侵略，赢得了阿拉伯國家的广泛支持，進一步推動了阿拉伯民族主義的高涨。英國與法國则在危机后加速了對殖民地的撤离步伐，标志着欧洲殖民主義的衰落。总體而言，戰争的结果重新确立了埃及對運河的合法控制，巩固了纳赛尔政权的合法性，并對后续的中東局势產生了持久的政治與軍事影响。
resultEn: In the end, the Second Middle East War concluded with a cease‑fire and the withdrawal of all belligerents. On 6 November 1956, under United Nations mediation and American‑Soviet pressure, Britain and France agreed to halt hostilities and began pulling their troops out of Port Said and the Canal zone by 7 November. Israel also withdrew from the Sinai by December, retaining only limited control over the Gaza Strip. Egypt reasserted full sovereignty over the Suez Canal and began a modernization program that would make the waterway one of the world’s busiest shipping lanes. Politically, Nasser’s victory over the Western powers boosted Arab nationalist sentiment and cemented his leadership in the Arab world, while Britain and France accelerated their retreat from empire, signaling the decline of European colonialism. In summary, the war restored Egyptian control of the Canal, fortified Nasser’s regime, and reshaped the political and military landscape of the Middle East for decades to come.
